verdict.rationale: kitty is a local terminal whose user data is mainly configuration and session definitions. Its documented kitty.conf is a plain-text config file, and a community user confirms it fits in a dotfiles repo, so the data is inherently portable. However, nothing documents an explicit export feature or covers other data such as scrollback or history. Missing for 10: a documented export/backup mechanism, coverage of non-config data (scrollback, session state), and explicit portability or migration guidance.
